---
title: "Timeline"
output: html_notebook
---
This notebook builds the timeline for the new timeline plot

```{r}
require(tidyverse)
require(ggplot2)

# read some data
BMJ_colours <- c("Palbociclib" = "#2a6ebb", "Abemaciclib"="#c50084","Ribociclib"="#00b2a9")

dates <- read_csv(here::here("data/KeyDates.csv"))

dates |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%d/%m/%Y")) |>
  mutate(event_date = as.Date(event_date, format = "%d/%m/%Y")) |>
  mutate(cdf_date = as.Date(cdf_date, format = "%d/%m/%Y")) -> dates
```

Start with a plot of the dates and a marker on a line

```{r}
dates |>
  ggplot(aes(x=event_date, y=0)) +
  geom_point()
```

Now remove the Y axis, remove backround and Y grid and plot a X-axis at 0 (manually)

```{r}
dates |>
  ggplot(aes(x=event_date, y=0)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  theme_void()
```

Add colours for the drugs

```{r}
dates |>
  ggplot(aes(x=event_date, y=0)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour=VTM)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  theme_void()
```


Add shapes for the events

```{r}
dates |>
  ggplot(aes(x=event_date, y=0)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_point(aes(colour=VTM, shape = type, size = 1.5)) +
  theme_void() 
  
```

Update the colour scheme and add x-axis date labels back in.  This looks odd, but will be fixed when plotting further labels.

```{r}

years  <- seq(2016, 2025)
dates |>
  ggplot(aes(x=date, y=0)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_segment(y=0, yend=-0.0035, x=as.Date(paste0(years,"-01-01")), xend=as.Date(paste0(years,"-01-01")), data = tibble(years))+
  geom_text(aes(y= -0.004, x=as.Date(paste0(years,"-01-01")), label=years), data = tibble(years))+
  geom_point(aes(colour=VTM, shape = type, size = 1.5)) +
  theme_void() +
  ggsci::scale_color_bmj() 

  
```
Plot labels and lines for the events
```{r}

dates |>
  arrange(event_date) ->dates

years  <- seq(2016, 2025)
dates |>
  ggplot(aes(x=event_date, y=0, colour= VTM)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_segment(y=0, yend=-0.035, x=as.Date(paste0(years,"-01-01")), xend=as.Date(paste0(years,"-01-01")), data = tibble(years), colour="black")+
  geom_text(aes(y= -0.04, x=as.Date(paste0(years,"-01-01")), label=years), size=2.5, colour="black", data = tibble(years))+
  geom_point(aes(colour=VTM, shape = type), size = 3) +
  theme_void() +
  ggsci::scale_color_bmj() +
  geom_text(aes(y= 0.8*((row(dates)[,1]%%2) - 0.5), x=event_date, label=str_wrap(event,12), colour = VTM), check_overlap = T, size=2.85)+
  geom_segment(y=0, yend= 0.6*((row(dates)[,1]%%2) - 0.5), x=dates$event_date, xend=dates$event_date)+
  ylim(-0.8,0.8)+
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

Plot the NICE implementation time limit (90days AFTER a NICE)

```{r}
dates |>
  ggplot(aes(x=event_date, y=0, colour= VTM)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_segment(y=0, yend=-0.035, x=as.Date(paste0(years,"-01-01")), xend=as.Date(paste0(years,"-01-01")), colour="black", data = tibble(years))+
  geom_text(aes(y= -0.04, x=as.Date(paste0(years,"-01-01")), label=years), size=2.5, colour="black", data = tibble(years))+
  geom_point(aes(colour=VTM, shape = type), size = 3) +
  theme_void() +
  ggsci::scale_color_bmj() +
  geom_text(aes(y= 0.8*((row(dates)[,1]%%2) - 0.5), x=event_date, label=str_wrap(event,12), colour = VTM), check_overlap = T, size=2.85)+
  geom_segment(y=0, yend= 0.6*((row(dates)[,1]%%2) - 0.5), x=dates$event_date, xend=dates$event_date)+
  ylim(-0.8,0.8)+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  geom_segment(y=0, yend=0, x=dates$event_date[dates$type=="NICE"], xend=dates$event_date[dates$type=="NICE"]+90, 
               data = dates[dates$type=="NICE",],
               arrow=arrow(
                 angle = 30, 
                 length = unit(0.05, "inches"), 
                 ends = "last", 
                 type = "open")
               )
```
Align text to create space & make markers hollow to show underlying markers
```{r}
dates |>
  ggplot(aes(x=event_date, y=0, colour= VTM)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_segment(y=0, yend=-0.035, x=as.Date(paste0(years,"-01-01")), xend=as.Date(paste0(years,"-01-01")), colour="black", data = tibble(years))+
  geom_text(aes(y= -0.04, x=as.Date(paste0(years,"-01-01")), label=years), size=2.5, colour="black", data = tibble(years))+
  geom_point(aes(colour=VTM, shape = type), size = 3, stroke = 0.98) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(9, 0,10))+
  theme_void() +
  ggsci::scale_color_bmj() +
  geom_text(aes(y= 0.8*((row(dates)[,1]%%2) - 0.5), x=event_date, label=str_wrap(event,12), colour = VTM, hjust=hjust), check_overlap = T, size=2.85)+
  geom_segment(y=((row(dates)[,1]%%2) - 0.5)*0.07, yend= 0.6*((row(dates)[,1]%%2) - 0.5), x=dates$event_date, xend=dates$event_date)+
  ylim(-0.8,0.8)+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  geom_segment(y=0, yend=0, x=dates$event_date[dates$type=="NICE"], xend=dates$event_date[dates$type=="NICE"]+90, 
               data = dates[dates$type=="NICE",],
               linewidth = 0.65,
               arrow=arrow(
                 angle = 30, 
                 length = unit(0.05, "inches"), 
                 ends = "last", 
                 type = "open")
               )
```
Add cdf time lines

```{r}
dates |>
  ggplot(aes(x=event_date, y=0, colour= VTM)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_segment(y=0, yend=-0.035, x=as.Date(paste0(years,"-01-01")), xend=as.Date(paste0(years,"-01-01")), colour="black", data = tibble(years))+
  geom_text(aes(y= -0.06, x=as.Date(paste0(years,"-01-01")), label=years), size=2.5, colour="black", data = tibble(years))+
  geom_point(aes(colour=VTM, shape = type), size = 2, stroke = 0.8) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(9,0,10))+
  theme_void() +
  #ggsci::scale_color_bmj() +
  scale_colour_manual(values=BMJ_colours)+
  geom_text(aes(y= 0.8*((row(dates)[,1]%%2) - 0.5), x=event_date, label=str_wrap(event,12), colour = VTM, hjust=hjust), check_overlap = T, size=2.85)+
  geom_segment(y=((row(dates)[,1]%%2) - 0.5)*0.07, yend= 0.6*((row(dates)[,1]%%2) - 0.5), x=dates$event_date, xend=dates$event_date)+
  ylim(-0.8,0.8)+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  geom_segment(y=0, yend=0, x=dates$event_date[dates$type=="NICE"], xend=dates$event_date[dates$type=="NICE"]+90, 
               data = dates[dates$type=="NICE",],
               linewidth = 0.55,
               arrow=arrow(
                 angle = 30, 
                 length = unit(0.05, "inches"), 
                 ends = "last", 
                 type = "open")
               )+
    geom_segment(y=0, yend=0, x=dates$event_date[dates$type=="NICE"], xend=dates$cdf_date[dates$type=="NICE"], 
               data = dates[dates$type=="NICE",],
               linewidth = 0.55,
               arrow=arrow(
                 angle = 90, 
                 length = unit(0.03, "inches"), 
                 ends = "last", 
                 type = "open")
               ) -> event_timeline

print(event_timeline)

ggsave(here::here("r/outputs/EventTimeLine.svg"), event_timeline, width = 8, height =4)
ggsave(here::here("r/outputs/EventTimeLine.png"), event_timeline, dpi = 350, width = 8, height =4)

```
